big_winner: a pick that made 25% or more on the trade
rules: Signal on day t, bought at the next open. Returns before costs; after_costs takes off 0.49% a round trip. index_pct and lead_pct are against the Nifty 500 over the sessions each pick was held. Stops are read on the close.
choice_rule: Among the new versions: the best 2017-2021 lead over the Nifty 500 (breakout, technical, flow, emerging) among versions with a pick on 25% of sessions, 150 picks in 2017-2021 and a profit after costs there; for quick trades the most picks rising on 2017-2021 among versions with a profit after costs and a lead over the index there. The 2022-2026 record is printed whatever it is.
